notes:
**Get chatting faster with free local models.** The first-run screen is back to one job: getting Ollama installed and running so you can start chatting right away.

**Onboarding**
- **Ollama-first setup.** New installs see a simple "Install Ollama to get started" screen (download it, open it, done), or "Start Ollama" when it's installed but stopped. Cloud sign-up is no longer part of first run.
- **It moves on by itself.** Once Ollama is running, ChatOSS notices within seconds. No more clicking Recheck.
- **One-click first model.** If Ollama has no models yet, ChatOSS recommends **ornith-1.5:9b**, a fast model that can reason, use tools, and understand images, and downloads it in the app with one progress bar (6.6 GB). It's also the default model on a fresh install. Browsing other models on Ollama is still one click away.
- **Fixed:** after downloading the model you were already set to use, the context gauge could show a 4K window and go red until you switched models.

**Cloud models**
- **Cloud models in the model picker.** Without a paid plan, cloud models show greyed out below your local models, with **Create account** (or **Choose a plan** when you're signed in). New accounts land on the Billing page to pick a cloud plan or a BYOK plan.
- **Upgrade** and **Choose a plan** now open the Billing page directly.
- The sign-in window has a **Create an account** link for new users.
- Already have a plan and setting up a new computer? The setup screen has a small **Sign in** link, so you don't need Ollama first.
